howItWorks.title: How to Build an Effective Mock Scrape
steps: Select a location along a natural travel corridor, field edge, or transition zone between bedding and feeding areas. Look for an overhanging limb (licking branch) 4–5 feet off the ground.
Clear a 3' x 3' area of leaves and debris down to bare soil beneath the licking branch.
Sprinkle 1–2 oz of Odin's Scrape Blend scent beads directly in the cleared area.
Apply Scrape Blend liquid to the licking branch itself — squirt it directly on the branch where a buck would make contact.
Set your trail camera 10–15 feet from the scrape, angled to capture the full scrape and licking branch.
howItWorks.note: The scent beads will work continuously for 30+ days regardless of weather. Unlike natural urine applied to a scrape (which washes away with the first rain), Odin's polymer beads are rain proof and continue releasing scent through rain, snow, and heavy dew.

syntheticVsNatural.title: Synthetic vs Natural Scrape Scent
syntheticVsNatural.body: Traditional mock scrape tactics involve pouring natural buck urine or tarsal gland scent into the scrape. This works for 24–48 hours until the scent degrades, soaks into the soil, or gets washed away by weather. Early in the season, scrapes can go dormant if there is not enough activity for visiting bucks to keep it alive. Odin's 30-day life ensures scents to attract bucks will be present when they start rolling by. Odin's Scrape Blend beads release continuously and consistently for 30+ days, meaning your mock scrape is actively producing scent even when you're not there. You don't need to go check on it, refresh it or replace it. Also, fewer field visits mean less human scent contamination at your setup — the most common reason mock scrapes fail. The National Deer Association offers some helpful information. Learn more from National Deer Association's: "A Guide to Rubs and Scrapes, The Social Media of the Deer World".

effectiveness.title: Proven Longer-Lasting Performance
effectiveness.body: Lab testing confirms Odin's synthetic scent beads maintain over 50% of their original scent output after 27 days of continuous outdoor exposure. Natural urine-based products degrade to negligible levels within 48 hours. For hunters managing multiple mock scrape sites, the difference between checking scrapes every 2 days versus every 30 days is the difference between hunting and managing scent stations.

items.q: What is the best scent for mock scrapes?
items.a: The most effective mock scrape scent combines both dominant buck pheromones (triggering territorial competition) and doe estrus (triggering breeding interest). Odin's Scrape Blend uses this dual-trigger approach with 100% synthetic formulations. The scent beads release continuously for 30+ days, keeping your mock scrape active far longer than a single application of natural dominant buck scent.

items.q: When should I start making mock scrapes?
items.a: Begin creating mock scrapes in early to mid-October in Northern states, when bucks are establishing territory and beginning to check scrape lines. This pre-rut window is the most productive period for mock scrape tactics. Deploy Odin's Scrape Blend beads and squirt Odin's liquid scrape blend on the licking branch, disperse on foliage or on a rope—bucks rely heavily on the overhead branch for scent communication.

items.q: How long does mock scrape scent last?
items.a: Odin's Scrape Blend scent beads last 30+ days continuously and are impervious to rain and moisture, so you'll be attracting bucks even in low-density areas or early in the pre-rut. The 30-day release keeps initiating activity even if individual bucks cycle through infrequently. Traditional natural urine applied to a mock scrape lasts 24–48 hours before degrading.

items.q: How can you tell the scrape scent is working?
items.a: Two things to watch for. First is activity—are bucks visiting the scrape? Second is their response: a buck that perceives a rival's scrape will act agitated, exhibit stiff-legged posture, bristled hair, and intensified licking branch engagement. The definitive confirmation is when the buck urinates over his tarsal glands into the scrape—that means the synthetic scent is reading as a real competitor's signature.

items.q: Is there anything I should do during the 30 days?
items.a: In most situations, no. Once the combination of Dominant Buck and Doe Estrus scents activate the scrape site, successive bucks will naturally mark their territory and keep it active. If you want to give it a boost, squirt some liquid scrape blend to refresh the licking branch or on a rope.

items.q: Do synthetic scrape scents really work?
items.a: Yes. Odin's synthetic scrape scents replicate the specific pheromone compounds that trigger territorial and breeding behavior in whitetail bucks. Our Scrape Blend has been field-tested over 10 seasons. The extended 30-day release outperforms natural urine because the scent remains active consistently and continuously instead of degrading within days.

October is the transition period in many parts of the country. You may also have Doe Estrus and Dominant Buck available because any individual doe's peak is biologically a 24–48-hour window. "Peak rut" as commonly used refers to when the highest percentage of does are entering estrus simultaneously—typically spanning 10–14 days. Scrape Blend is perfect during this period, and you may add extra Doe Estrus or Dominant Buck depending on what you're reading in your area.

items.q: Which attracts more bucks: dominant buck scent vs doe estrus?
items.a: Odin's Scrape Blend is a precise blend of Doe in Estrus and Dominant Buck scents meant for the transition period in nature. It is difficult to gauge what is best across a population of deer in any given area. You may have does and bucks in different stages across a three-week period.
